title: NEB Class 11 English — Grammar — 2024
subject: english
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'The teacher gave the students homework.'
questions.solution:
**Passive:** The students were given homework by the teacher.

Rule: Object becomes subject; verb becomes 'be + past participle'; original subject becomes 'by + agent'.
questions.knowledgeNote: Double object sentences: either object can become subject in passive voice.
